article.title: Nvidia’s monopoly breaks, and the chip blockade couldn’t save it
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The law can keep Nvidia’s chips out of China. It cannot give Nvidia back the market it once had to itself. China is not building an empire to replace the United States’ one. Its engineers and workers, organized by plan, are doing at scale and at speed what the monopolies counted on keeping to themselves, and every year they do that, there is less superprofit to hold the old order up.
